messages:
ellen: Quick sync — planning an 8-10 design partner cohort focused on inference observability (telemetry SDK, traces, per-route latency/cost). Want a mix of ~4 startups and ~4 mid-market/enterprise. Timeline: recruitment + NDAs in the next 6 weeks. Need alignment on screening q's, onboarding cadence, success criteria, and gating. Thoughts?

marta: Love it. Screening ideas: 1) primary deployment mode (hosted/dedicated/private)? 2) latency targets? 3) current observability stack? 4) willingness to run eval prompts + share metrics. Keep them 3-4 quick q's.

sam: Engineering ask — we can ship a lightweight telemetry SDK + sample app. Need to cap custom integration work to ~2 eng-weeks total across the cohort. @ellen can we prioritize which SDK variants (python/node/go)?

ellen: Yes — python + node primary, go optional. We'll offer a lightweight adapter for KV-cache traces. Limit custom infra work to high-fit enterprise only.

rahul: CS availability: I can take ~2 hours/week for onboarding + weekly office hours. For enterprise partners we should offer a weekly check-in + a clear escalation path. Also need a documented support SLA for config changes.

olivia: Onboarding checklist (draft): 1) NDA signed, 2) pre-reqs doc, 3) SDK snippet + sample app, 4) smoke test script, 5) baseline metrics capture script, 6) survey link. Recommend a 2-week onboarding window before starting evals.

ci-bot: :white_check_mark: New doc created: https://docs.internal/redwood/dp-observability-onboard-v1 (placeholder)

marta: Feedback cadence proposal: short weekly 6-question survey + biweekly 30-min interviews with product + eng. Capture prompts, failure modes, and latency/cost deltas. Use a shared spreadsheet for metrics collection.

ellen: Launch gating (proposed): - 80% of core flows pass partner smoke tests (generation, streaming, trace capture) - no unresolved P0s - telemetry ingestion stable at partner scale - at least 6 partners actively sending eval data - signed data-sharing consents.

sam: Proposed v1 scope: telemetry SDK + KV/prefix traces + per-route token/cost breakdown. Defer custom quantization or inference-compiler work to v2. Keep cohort limited to hosted + dedicated customers for now.

rahul: Success criteria (customer POV): reduce MTTI for perf regressions by >=30% during cohort; clear cost-delta visibility; actionable alerts for tail latency. We should instrument baseline (week 0) metrics so we can measure impact.

olivia: Agree. Also capture qualitative signals: frequency partners act on alerts, how understandable dashboards are, and friction in onboarding.

ellen: Screening q's (final shortlist): 1) deployment mode, 2) typical traffic pattern (qps / burstiness), 3) willingness to run weekly evals + share anonymized metrics, 4) primary success metric. I'll draft the screener doc.

marta: I'll sketch the 6-question weekly survey + interview guide template.

sam: I'll scope SDK work and add a small RFC that caps custom work and outlines auth/telemetry hooks. ETA: EOD Wed.

rahul: I'll prepare the CS playbook + escalation matrix. ETA: Fri COB.

olivia: I'll finalize onboarding checklist + smoke test scripts.

ellen: Action items recap: ellen create invite list + screener doc; marta survey + interview guide; sam SDK RFC; rahul CS playbook; olivia onboarding checklist final. Reconvene next Tue 10am PT. Sheet: https://sheets.internal/redwood/dp-observability-cohort (placeholder).

olivia: 👍

marta: :raised_hands:

sam: Noted. I'll ping infra to reserve capacity slots during the cohort window.

ellen: Thanks team — aiming to open invites in 2 weeks. If anyone wants to add candidate companies, add them to the sheet before Friday.
